why: The copy logic is correct. It allocates a new array of the same size, loops over every index, and assigns copy[i] = data2[i]. But it uses data2.length() twice, and arrays have a length field, not a length() method, so it won't compile. This is one repeated slip in an otherwise rule-correct solution, so it is L2 with an error and not L0. It isn't L3 or L4 because the code doesn't work and nothing beyond the copy loop is related or reasoned about.
